<trans-unit id="S-12-10000-10025">
<source>&lt;p>The administration page allows application owners (Administrators) to configure the application and maintain common data used across the application.
By selecting one of the available settings, administrators can potentially change how the application is displayed and/or features available to the end users.&lt;/p>
&lt;p>Access to this page should be limited to Administrators only.&lt;/p></source>
<TranslatedText>&lt;p>The administration page allows application owners (Administrators) to configure the application and maintain common data used across the application.
By selecting one of the available settings, administrators can potentially change how the application is displayed and/or features available to the end users.&lt;/p>
&lt;p>Access to this page should be limited to Administrators only.&lt;/p></TranslatedText>
</trans-unit>
<trans-unit id="S-12-10010-10025">
<source>&lt;p>Select the appropriate choice for any authenticated users.&lt;br> 
Selecting &lt;strong>No&lt;/strong> makes the application more secure as only specified users can access the application. 
However, if your application has a large user community then maintaining users may be onerous, and you may prefer to choose &lt;strong>Yes&lt;/strong> and only enter application Administrators, and possibly Contributors.&lt;br>
If you select &lt;strong>Yes&lt;/strong> then you must also select how users not included in the users list are treated.&lt;/p>
&lt;p>Select between requiring email addresses and any alphanumeric value for Usernames.&lt;br>
Generally, you should set this setting to &lt;strong>E-mail Address&lt;/strong> if your application uses (or will be configured to use) a centralized authentication scheme such as Oracle Access Manager, or SSO.&lt;/p>
&lt;p>&lt;em>&lt;strong>Note:&lt;/strong> This application supports the following 3 access levels: Reader, Contributor, and Administrator.
&lt;ul>
  &lt;li>&lt;strong>Readers&lt;/strong> have read-only access to all information and can also view reports.&lt;/li>
  &lt;li>&lt;strong>Contributors&lt;/strong> can create, edit and delete information and view reports.&lt;/li>
  &lt;li>&lt;strong>Administrators&lt;/strong>, in addition to Contributors capability, can also perform configuration of the application by accessing the Administration section of the application.&lt;/li>
&lt;/ul>
&lt;/em>&lt;/p></source>

Selecting &lt;strong>No&lt;/strong> makes the application more secure as only specified users can access the application. 
However, if your application has a large user community then maintaining users may be onerous, and you may prefer to choose &lt;strong>Yes&lt;/strong> and only enter application Administrators, and possibly Contributors.&lt;br>
If you select &lt;strong>Yes&lt;/strong> then you must also select how users not included in the users list are treated.&lt;/p>

&lt;p>&lt;em>&lt;strong>Note:&lt;/strong> This application supports the following 3 access levels: Reader, Contributor, and Administrator.
&lt;ul>

<trans-unit id="S-12-10011-10025">
<source>&lt;p>This page shows a report of the application users and the access level granted.&lt;/p>
&lt;p>Click on the column headings to sort and filter data, or click on the &lt;strong>Actions&lt;/strong> button to customize column display and many additional advanced features.&lt;br>
Click the &lt;strong>Reset&lt;/strong> button to reset the interactive report back to the default settings.&lt;/p>
&lt;p>Click the edit icon (yellow pencil) to edit the user details and access level, or to delete the user.&lt;/p>
&lt;p>Click &lt;strong>Add User&lt;/strong>, at the top of the report, to add a new user and their access level.&lt;/p></source>
<TranslatedText>&lt;p>This page shows a report of the application users and the access level granted.&lt;/p>
&lt;p>Click on the column headings to sort and filter data, or click on the &lt;strong>Actions&lt;/strong> button to customize column display and many additional advanced features.&lt;br>
Click the &lt;strong>Reset&lt;/strong> button to reset the interactive report back to the default settings.&lt;/p>
&lt;p>Click the edit icon (yellow pencil) to edit the user details and access level, or to delete the user.&lt;/p>
&lt;p>Click &lt;strong>Add User&lt;/strong>, at the top of the report, to add a new user and their access level.&lt;/p></TranslatedText>
</trans-unit>
<trans-unit id="S-12-10012-10025">
<source>&lt;p>Use this form to enter users, their email address and set their access level. 
The settings defined under &lt;em>Configure Access Control&lt;/em> will determine whether the username must be their email address or can be any alphanumeric entry.&lt;/p>
&lt;p>This application supports the following 3 access levels: Reader, Contributor, and Administrator.&lt;/p>
&lt;ul>
  &lt;li>&lt;strong>Readers&lt;/strong> have read-only access to all information and can also view reports.&lt;/li>
  &lt;li>&lt;strong>Contributors&lt;/strong> can create, edit and delete information and view reports.&lt;/li>
  &lt;li>&lt;strong>Administrators&lt;/strong>, in addition to Contributors capability, can also perform configuration of the application by accessing the Administration section of the application.&lt;/li>
&lt;/ul>
&lt;p>When editing an existing user you can lock their account which will prevent them from accessing the application.&lt;/p>
&lt;p>&lt;em>&lt;strong>Note:&lt;/strong>   If using Oracle Application Express accounts then users entered here must also be defined as end users by a Workspace Administrator, who can also set their password.&lt;/em>&lt;/p></source>
<TranslatedText>&lt;p>Use this form to enter users, their email address and set their access level. 
The settings defined under &lt;em>Configure Access Control&lt;/em> will determine whether the username must be their email address or can be any alphanumeric entry.&lt;/p>
&lt;p>This application supports the following 3 access levels: Reader, Contributor, and Administrator.&lt;/p>
&lt;ul>
  &lt;li>&lt;strong>Readers&lt;/strong> have read-only access to all information and can also view reports.&lt;/li>
  &lt;li>&lt;strong>Contributors&lt;/strong> can create, edit and delete information and view reports.&lt;/li>
  &lt;li>&lt;strong>Administrators&lt;/strong>, in addition to Contributors capability, can also perform configuration of the application by accessing the Administration section of the application.&lt;/li>
&lt;/ul>
&lt;p>When editing an existing user you can lock their account which will prevent them from accessing the application.&lt;/p>
&lt;p>&lt;em>&lt;strong>Note:&lt;/strong>   If using Oracle Application Express accounts then users entered here must also be defined as end users by a Workspace Administrator, who can also set their password.&lt;/em>&lt;/p></TranslatedText>
</trans-unit>

<source>&lt;p>
If you select this checkbox, the application will save your username in a persistent browser cookie named "LOGIN_USERNAME_COOKIE".
When you go to the login page the next time,
the username field will be automatically populated with this value.
&lt;/p>
&lt;p>
If you deselect this checkbox and your username is already saved in the cookie,
the application will overwrite it with an empty value.
You can also use your browser's developer tools to completely remove the cookie.
&lt;/p></source>

&lt;/p>
&lt;p>
